extension.summary: Free kids' shows, cartoons and videos from HappyKids (unofficial)
extension.description:
Browse and play HappyKids' free kids' catalogue: Discover, Gaming, Ages 0-4, Ages 4-6, Ages 6-9, Tweens, LEGO and Español, with shows by season, search and My List. Streams are played through InputStream Adaptive; no DRM module is needed.
No account or sign-up -- the service has none. HappyKids runs on Future Today's platform (the same one as Fawesome); this add-on uses its undocumented website API and may need updating when the site changes.
Known gaps: the service is ad-supported and its web player requests ads separately from the video (client-side VMAP). This add-on plays the programme stream only and does not insert those ads. It is US-centric; the catalogue may differ or be unavailable elsewhere.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Future Today Inc. HappyKids is a trademark of Future Today Inc.
extension.news: 2026.11.21 - First test build - Browse HappyKids' sections by age group, open shows by season, search, and play. - My List (watchlist), search, subtitles where available, and a self-heal when the site ships a new build -- all shared with the Fawesome add-on.
